summary.name: Pictory
summary.one_liner: Pictory is an AI video agent and generator that turns text, scripts, URLs, PowerPoint files, audio, images or a one-line idea into edited videos with scenes, captions, AI voices and avatars.
keywords: make short videos from long content
use_cases: Turning a blog post or article into a short video
Converting a PowerPoint deck into a narrated video
Producing marketing ads and product explainers
Creating corporate training and onboarding videos
Making social media clips in platform aspect ratios
Animating a still image into a short video clip
summary.what_it_does: Pictory is an AI video generator and agent. You describe a video or start from a script, article, URL, PowerPoint, images, audio or screen recording, and the agent plans the script and scenes for you to review. It adds AI voices, captions, stock or AI-generated visuals, and optional avatars, then produces a preview you can edit by chat or in the editor before generating the final file. The AI Studio section describes image and video generation, character consistency, clip extension and generating up to four variants. It also lists horizontal, vertical and square aspect ratios, brand kits, translation, team workspaces, an API, and Make and Zapier workflow connections.
notable: Agent-based workflow: describe a brief, review the generated script and scenes, then refine before generating
Accepts many inputs: text, script, URL, PowerPoint, audio, images and screen recordings
AI Studio for generating and editing images and video clips with reference-image character consistency
Make and Zapier integrations plus a developer API
caveats: Free trial includes 300 credits and no credit card; further use depends on credits or paid plans, with pricing not detailed on the page
Enterprise features such as custom plans and onboarding require contacting the company
Page is largely marketing; specific output limits and plan prices are not stated
